hero.name: Pranav Patel
hero.role: Business & Data Analyst · Power BI · SQL · Excel · Business Intelligence
hero.bio: MBA Business Analytics candidate with hands-on experience in CRM operations, sales pipeline management, data analysis and workflow automation — transforming raw data into actionable insights and interactive dashboards.

about: I combine business understanding with technical problem-solving to support data-driven decision-making, process optimization and business intelligence initiatives. My work spans CRM operations, sales pipeline management, dashboard development and automation of routine business workflows.

Skilled in transforming business requirements and raw data into actionable insights, interactive dashboards and automated business solutions — using Power BI, SQL, Excel, Power Query, DAX and no-code automation platforms like N8N.

experience.title: BDA Intern — CRM Software
bullets: Managed sales workflows, lead pipelines and follow-up activities within DIGIESALE CRM, improving lead visibility and sales process organization.
Analyzed prospect requirements and customer pain points to conduct personalized outreach via LinkedIn and WhatsApp.
Coordinated live product demonstrations, supporting prospect engagement and communication throughout the sales cycle.
Created and managed WhatsApp Business API (WABA) templates for structured bulk communication and outreach campaigns.
Used AI tools and workflow-based scheduling to create and publish marketing content across social media platforms.

achievements.text: Successfully completed a 45-day internship at Knowledge Square LLP, gaining practical experience in CRM operations, sales workflows, business development, customer engagement and digital automation.
